Industry Opportunity Radar v0.1.0 – Initial Release

- Enables tracking of industry changes using snapshots in JishuDB for evidence-backed briefings.
- Supports comparison of new and prior industry reports, indicators, and competitor evidence.
- Establishes a monitored baseline on first run; recurring analyses require explicit authorized scheduling.
- Outputs include industry briefings, indicator changes, hypotheses, risks, and open questions in both markdown and CSV.
- Requires compatible host setup with JishuDB connection and approved output capabilities; enforces strict evidence handling and authorization checks.
